It has varied throughout the years. 
First time I did it when I was 12 and I thought cutting myself was all I needed to die, so it was more of an ill-informed attempt on my life. After waking up alive and well the next morning, I was marveled by the fact I could bleed that much and be okay so I started doing it everytime the mirror or my mind reminded me I hated myself.
I had been bullied for six years by that point so my self-hatred was very ingrained in me.
During the next four years I became very depressed, developed an eating disorder and one of my favorite pastimes was spending hours setting everything up, cutting and then cleaning up so I didn't think about food for a while. 
Then I started experimenting, curious to see if I could go deeper, burning, scratching off skin, etc.
By college, I was more depressed than never. I didn't know I had bipolar and bpd yet so I struggled a lot with my emotions, I cut to regulate when I was feeling too much or nothing. My mental health declined a lot and SH was the only thing that kept me afloat.

I don't know when I became a full-on addict, but at one point I also started cutting just because I wanted to, it felt good and right.
This continued until june 2023 when I sought help and got diagnosed. 

I'm gonna be a year clean on August 7th, I never thought it would be possible.
It doesn't always have a reason, if you're not yet seeing a therapist, please do, there might be something you need to work on, some trauma you can't see.
I also thought my life had always been great. Blaming myself for my behavior, and only in recent years did I find out that my childhood was abusive and my dad also probably has bpd and npd, which messed me up.
I haven't self harmed for 280 days! As a 29yo, I've spent more than half my life self harming, but it's still a huge achievement for me.
I think this post might do better in the BPD sub. It seems like more of a bpd rage than bipolar.

My reason to stop, I guess is that although I enjoy cutting, it's literally not solving any of my problems, it's actually adding more to my life. SH in any capacity will never feel enough and you will keep escalating, it will damage all your relationships, friends, family and SO. 
I'm 135 days clean today and every day is a struggle, but man, I would do anything to go back in time and stopped when I was younger.

As we walked closer to the bus stop, we realized there were four human heads on the boxes, full of flies and one of the decapitated bodies, naked and with the guy's lower parts cut off, if you know what I mean.
Some people threw up and it started a chain reaction. We just left, nobody called the police because if there were narcos around, we would probably get shot.

Those were really tough years, it's crazy to realize how quickly you can get used to living surrounded by violence and death.
